producer_report.summary: The producer loop now runs the decision gate on the work tree after each report. A change that touches governed code without a log entry and link gets one send-back carrying the gate's exact message. That send-back is the same one unmet criteria use, so a producer already sent back for criteria gets none for the gate. If the change is still unreconciled afterwards, the loop exits and the unchanged gate in `check_and_verify` fails the job with today's message. The gate-only exhaustion prints a new line, `producer   decisions still not reconciled after the send-back; the job ends at the decision gate`, and not the 'verifier will judge it' line. The producer prompt also gets a `## Decisions that govern files you will change` section, added after the plan. It lists each governing decision, the planned paths it governs, and the rule: a log entry in `docs/decisions.md` plus a `[[link]]` whose `older` is the decision and whose `newer` is the entry. A list that can't be read sends no one back and prints no new line, so the existing warning still prints once. New code: `athena_data::decision_links::governing`, `athena_context::briefs::{governing_decisions_section, producer_prompt_with_governing}`, `decision_gate` and `unreconciled_in_snapshot` in `checks.rs`, and `send_back_text_full` in `send_back.rs`. The gate's message text and `GATE_REASON_PREFIX` are unchanged. Tests added: two run tests, the prompt test, brief and data unit tests, and a send-back text test. The two existing governed-edit tests, the retry test and the unreadable-list test were adjusted for the extra producer run and the new prompt order. CHANGELOG.md has one entry.

criteria_check.criterion: A run test (cargo test -p athena-core) where the producer's first candidate touches a path governed by a decision in the base docs/decision-links.toml and adds no log entry or link shows the producer invoked a second time with a send-back brief that contains the gate's message (GATE_REASON_PREFIX and the decision id); the second candidate adds the entry and [[link]] and the job proceeds to checks and the verifier.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core governed_edit_is_sent_back_once_and_the_second_candidate_reaches_the_verifier` passes. Producer count is 2 and verifier count is 1. The second prompt contains '## Sent back', GATE_REASON_PREFIX, 'D02 (README.md)' and '[[link]]', and the first prompt has no '## Sent back'. The job ends Landed with a 'checks     ' UI line and exactly one 'producer   sent back: decisions not reconciled' line.

criteria_check.criterion: A run test (cargo test -p athena-core) where the producer's second candidate is still unreconciled ends the job as failed with exactly today's gate message (starting with GATE_REASON_PREFIX, naming each decision and touched path and the fix), after exactly one send-back and no third producer run.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core governed_edit_still_unreconciled_after_the_send_back_ends_with_the_gate_message` passes. The state is Failed and the reason equals the literal message built from GATE_REASON_PREFIX. The producer count is 2, there are 2 prompts, and the verifier count is 0. The UI has the gate-limit line, has no 'the verifier will judge it' line, has no 'checks     ' line, and has a 'failed     decisions not reconciled:' line.

criteria_check.criterion: A brief test (cargo test -p athena-context or -p athena-core) shows the producer prompt for a plan that expects a governed file to change names the governing decision id, the governed path, and the rule (log entry plus matching [[link]] whose older is the decision and newer the new entry); a plan with no governed file adds no such section.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core the_producer_prompt_names_the_decisions_governing_the_planned_files` passes. The first producer prompt contains the section, 'D02 governs README.md', '[[link]]' and 'docs/decisions.md', and not D12. A job over a repository with no list has no heading. `cargo test -p athena-context governing_decisions` passes. It checks the older/newer rule text and that empty input leaves the prompt equal to the input.

criteria_check.criterion: The unreconciled_decisions message text and athena_data::decision_links::GATE_REASON_PREFIX are unchanged, so the retry reader (reading::retry_findings) still recognises a gated job; the existing gate tests in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs still pass.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: the plan said `decision_gate` takes a read-the-candidate closure. I made it take the base list text, the changed paths and a closure that returns the base log, candidate list and candidate log (struct DecisionTexts). The behavior is the same.

Departure from the plan: the plan's step 6 said to wrap the prompt with the governing section after the plan block. I apply it after the `if planned` block, so unplanned jobs also get it from the reading's deliverables. A job with no governed planned file still gets today's prompt.

In producer_loop, a gate-only send-back prints `producer   sent back: decisions not reconciled`. That short text is also pushed into the problems that go into the invocation record's detail (`self-check failed: ...`), but not into report_gaps.
mistakes: My first full-suite run printed more output than the tool could show and I could not read the saved file, so I reran the whole suite with -q. That cost a second suite run.
learnings: send_back_text and send_back_text_with_replay are used in non-test code only through producer_loop. Keeping them live there avoids dead-code warnings under clippy -D warnings, so the loop picks among the three send-back builders.
Only snapshot.rs and candidate.rs are governed (D08) in the base docs/decision-links.toml, so this change's own gate does not fire.
Snapshot::change_list gives DiffEntry with status and new_oid, and Snapshot::blob reads the work-tree text, so the gate can run before a candidate commit exists.
The loop's gate-only exhaustion prints only the new gate line; the old 'the verifier will judge it' line and report_gaps are untouched for criteria problems.
desires: A way to read a saved large tool output inside the working directory; the first full-suite output was unreadable and the suite had to be rerun.
